contract_proofs.title: Producer-backed application and restart
contract_proofs.proved: Actual O1/O2/O3 producers create W1/W2/W3 claims, custody, frozen originals and semantic evidence; O4 derives the contract view and applies exact tuples/Profile/configuration identities. A separate PHP process resolves the committed pair.

contract_proofs.title: Exact selection and whole-pair refusal
contract_proofs.proved: Producer-backed zero, sole, multiple tied, ranked two-tier lower-middle, unknown-order and coupled-pair boundaries. Original typed selector/parser cases cover odd/even tiers, equivalent identities, permutations, entire FIT coverage, malformed/duplicate/extra ranks and role/Profile scope. No fallback or application consumption on refusal.

contract_proofs.title: Authority and fresh-use refusal
contract_proofs.proved: A policy-derived application and B distinct signed act. Missing/wrong-scope act, stale head/predecessor, same-ID conflict, expired policy/trust, revoked act/policy/issuer, Profile/binding generation changes, unavailable model, missing semantic port/originals, corrupt response/raw original/fence/alternate application entry refuse without writes or HTTP. Settings consumer checks exact model/generation and preserves prepared transport.

contract_proofs.title: Replay and competing whole-pair writers
contract_proofs.proved: Same-ID replay and conflict; cross-ID duplicate, cross-policy/sequence ID refusal; concurrent initial writers and concurrent independently signed replacements against one predecessor produce one winner. Consumed initial authority is not reopened.

contract_proofs.title: Publication interruption and recovery
contract_proofs.proved: Real process exit before the fsynced-file rename leaves zero application; exit immediately after successful rename retains one complete pair. Fresh-process snapshot/resolve, response-loss replay and evidence-only Recovery.resume preserve application history. This is a process-interruption proof, not arbitrary machine power-loss durability.

contract_proofs.title: Persistent settings and explicit replacement
contract_proofs.proved: Exact settings survive process restart, unavailability, credential rotation, replacement, expiry and revocation. New use fails on currentness/generation failure with no substitute. Fresh signed whole-pair replacement advances both generations; stale/unauthorized changes refuse. Revalidation does not write, spend a right or fetch a catalogue. Catalogue state has no input path into historical snapshot/replay; no catalogue polling/reassignment is implemented or claimed.

contract_proofs.title: Migration, preservation and regression gates
contract_proofs.proved: Explicit bounded v4 migration preserves signed/raw original maps and prior consumption and refuses malformed versions. Original O1/O2/O3, FC/native/reviewer/R1/R2 and frozen-inventory checks are exercised; protected originals and test fixtures are byte-compared in the package. The unchanged full local suite was run with its 1800-second allowance; its exact result is separate. Fresh complete hosted O4 CI remains required before integration.
